required_review: Whisper resonance, relevance, and trajectory substrate

checks.check: profile completeness and allowed or blocked output boundary
catalog type and project-local alias selection
pinned source existence and SHA-256 bindings
unique source, node, edge, and knowledge-record identifiers
closed kind, predicate, endpoint, policy-owner, evidence, commitment, and intent vocabularies
all local entities mentioned by the Chapter 1 artifact
every encounter has a participant and place
no premature author-accepted or frozen-baseline commitments

material_findings: knowledge-vault is the correct primary catalog type
intent state remains volatile while Chapter 1 acceptance is pending
evidence and commitment confidence must remain separate
bracelet drift, mysteries, reserve material, and Saint Orison non-inference must remain explicit
ontology cannot accept prose, settle mysteries, change Craft, or make derivatives authoritative

synthesis_evidence.use: Reused Whisper composition provenance, bounded project-local character/place/encounter kinds, and closed-world policy posture.
synthesis_evidence.authority: audited research findings, not ontology admission

craft.evidence: All row references resolve; required embedded indexes are fresh; registered artifact paths exist; the human view exposes the tracked ontology context, gate, decision, gaps, and artifacts.

documents.evidence: Markdown links resolve, JSON parses, pinned receipt hashes match, and scoped trailing-whitespace checks are clean.

residue: Author review of the ontology remains pending.
Props, typed contracts and requests, and richer story relations remain deferred.
Chapter 2 and long-arc evidence do not exist.
Graphic and audio derivatives remain unsynchronized.
No runtime, query engine, Inventory projection, publication, promotion, release, or canonical admission is proved.
next_action: The author reviews the Whisper intent, entity set, knowledge roles, and deferred semantics, then accepts or corrects the candidate ontology.
